caption: The drawing depicts a single upholstered armchair with a high, curved backrest and winged sides. The chair’s upholstery is covered in vertical stripes of varying widths in shades of blue, green, and cream. The seat and armrests feature the same striped pattern as the backrest and sides. The chair has curved, padded arms and a rectangular seat. The chair is supported by four legs: the front legs are turned and finished, shown in a brown wood tone, while the back legs are straight and slightly tapered with a similar brown finish. The background is plain and unadorned, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Chair, Wing, Turned Front Legs
